import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    g=np.exp(-p[9]*eps)
    return p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*eps*T+p[4]*eps*T**2+p[5]*eps**p[8]+p[6]*eps**p[8]*T+p[7]*g
